messages:

Subject: Re: Annual advance arrangement - request for proposed allocation cadence

Mina, thanks for the intro last week. We’d like to lock an annual advance for 2028 to cover expected usage across our Product+Services teams. Can you send a proposed schedule for how Redwood prefers to release prepaid funds over the year (invoice timing + drawdown windows)? Key constraints from our side:
- We need invoices that align to our SOW milestone model (initial platform integration + three quarterly checkpoints).
- Prefer net-30 payment terms.
- We operate entities in US (BlueWave, Inc.) and EU (BlueWave B.V.) — need clarity on VAT handling per invoice.

If you can share a single-sheet schedule (amount by date, invoice type, and any holdback/reserve), we’ll route it to procurement and tax.

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-29T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Annual advance allocation: draft cap & vest proposal

Elena — appreciate the clarity. Drafting a proposal that maps invoices to your milestone structure rather than a pure calendar cadence makes sense. High-level proposal below; attached is a worksheet with the line items (redwood_advance_schedule.xlsx).

Proposed cap-and-vest structure (example for $1,000,000 committed):
- Invoice 1 (initial activation): 40% upfront ($400k) — Invoice issued at contract signature/SOW kickoff.
- Vesting pool: 55% ($550k) released in three equal milestone tranches tied to your Q1/Q2/Q3 platform checkpoints (~18.33% each).
- Contingency reserve: 5% ($50k) held for usage drift and can be invoiced later upon mutual sign-off.
- Drawdown windows: monthly consumption reporting; charges will be applied against the prepaid balance with a monthly statement.

Operational notes:
- We can issue the initial invoice to BlueWave, Inc. (US) or BlueWave B.V. (EU) based on the billing entity you provide. For EU invoices to BlueWave B.V. we can mark VAT as reverse charge if you provide valid EU VAT ID and evidence.
- Standard terms: Net-30. We will include line-level memo linking invoices to milestones so your AP team can match to POs.

Next steps requested from you:
1) Confirm which legal entity should receive Invoice 1.
2) Share the PO number (or indicate that you’ll approve via DocuSign).
3) Confirm whether you want the contingency to be automatically invoiced at year-end or held pending sign-off.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if helpful. I’ve looped Kar (karthik_iyer) and Soojin (soojin_lee) to weigh in on the tax and ledger implications.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

--

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Date: 2027-11-30T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Annual advance allocation: tax notes and invoice formatting

Adding tax/ops context for the proposed cap-and-vest: 
- EU VAT: If BlueWave B.V. will be billed, we need their VAT ID and confirmation that they’re the importer of record; then we can issue a zero-VAT invoice with reverse-charge language. If they want the invoice to BlueWave, Inc. (US) for the whole amount, EU entity will need to internally reallocate — that can complicate your reclaim flow.
- Withholdings: none expected for US/EU crossbill here, but local govts vary for some countries — flag if any AP will pay from a LATAM/EMEA hub.
- Accounting/ledger: initial invoice should be coded to "Deferred Revenue — Prepaid Annual" and then amortized monthly against usage. If they want contingency to remain as a separate reserve, we’ll create a sub-ledger tag to avoid double-counting.

Attachments I recommend we send with the first invoice: invoice_template_US-EU.pdf (VAT language variants) and the schedule spreadsheet.

— Soojin
Director, Revenue Ops Tax & Compliance

Elena — thanks, understood and we can accommodate. Final decisions/changes below; I’ve attached a draft invoice for the activation tranche and an updated schedule (invoice_template_US-EU.pdf).

Confirmed changes: 
- Initial 40% ($400k) will be invoiced upon completion of the SOW milestone "Platform Integration Complete" — we'll mark the invoice with the milestone ID and link it to the SOW.
- Invoice routing: issue initial invoice to BlueWave, Inc. (US) as requested; include a memo line stating "EU entity will claim reverse-charge; please provide VAT ID on remittance."
- VAT: if BlueWave B.V. confirms VAT ID, we will issue subsequent EU-facing invoices with reverse-charge language. Soojin will generate the EU wording variant for the final invoice pack.
- Contingency holdback: will remain configurable. Default behavior: hold as a separate reserve line and only invoice upon mutual sign-off; if you prefer automatic year-end invoicing, indicate when you send the PO.

Deliverables we will send immediately after you provide PO:
1) Draft Invoice 1 (activation) — PDF (invoice_template_US-EU.pdf attached).
2) Updated schedule spreadsheet that shows milestone dates & expected invoice dates (redwood_advance_schedule.xlsx).
3) DocuSign envelope linking the SOW and the billing addendum (https://www.docusign.com/envelope/ABC12345).

If all looks good, we’ll expect the PO by 2027-12-06 and will target issuing the draft invoice within 24 hours of the PO receipt so AP can process net-30.

Best regards,
